Tarikh | Episode 1011 | 01 July 2025
Dubai was historically a fishing and pearl-diving village.
Sheikh Rashid bin Saeed Al Maktoum envisioned a future beyond oil, focusing on trade and infrastructure.
Strategic investments in ports and tax-free policies attracted global businesses.
The establishment of Emirates Airlines, tourism, real estate, and financial services dominate, with crude oil contributing only 1% to Dubai's GDP.
